title: IT BLEW UP. what's the least bad way to say RUD

messages.content: IT BLEW UP!!!! need hr-safe way 2 say the leviathan had a rud! spin it as a data-gathering success!!!!! post b4 vanguard tweets!!!!!!!!

I understand you're eager to get ahead of the narrative. Here's a draft:

"Today, SpaceY's Leviathan achieved a rapid unscheduled disassembly shortly after liftoff. This event provided invaluable data that will enhance our future mission planning and vehicle designs. Every test pushes us closer to Mars. We'll share more insights soon."

Does this align with what you're aiming for, or would you like to tweak anything?
chad will say it's a failure need more oomph! make it clear we learned LOTS!!!!

Understood. Let's emphasize the learning aspect:

"During today’s mission, SpaceY's Leviathan contributed significantly to our understanding through a rapid disassembly shortly after liftoff. This milestone offered unprecedented insights that will refine our engineering and accelerate us towards interplanetary colonization. Every setback is a step forward on our path to Mars. More details to come soon."

Would this framing help counter Chad Vanguard’s narrative?
perfect!!! zing with a meme at the end? add flamethrowers??? or is that too much

I’d recommend keeping the focus sharp on the mission's learning value, but a touch of levity could work if done subtly. How about this:

"...Every setback is a step forward on our path to Mars. Remember, even when things disassemble, we're still fired up for the journey ahead!"

This keeps the tone positive without overdoing it. Does this strike the right balance?
